post-1.title: Meta tightened enforcement on Gambling-vertical accounts, EU
post-1.content: Over the past 48 hours, more than 500 messages across monitored Telegram channels reported a wave of bans on Gambling-vertical Meta accounts in the EU, with several agencies noting faster detection of cloaked landing pages.
post-1.recommendation: Reduce exposure in Gambling EU by 15-20% until the situation stabilizes; prioritize warmed, aged accounts over freshly farmed ones.

post-2.title: Potential regulatory changes for Crypto advertising in LATAM
post-2.content: Multiple regional sources are discussing a possible tightening of advertising rules for Crypto offers in Brazil and Mexico, though no official announcement has been made yet.
post-2.recommendation: Avoid scaling new Crypto campaigns in LATAM until the regulatory picture is clearer; monitor official sources over the next 1-2 weeks.

post-3.title: TikTok algorithm update affecting broad targeting
post-3.content: TikTok appears to have adjusted its ad-review algorithm, resulting in higher rejection rates for broad-targeted campaigns across several verticals over the last week.
post-3.recommendation: Test narrower, interest-based targeting on TikTok before running broad campaigns; expect higher rejection rates in the short term.

brief-1.title: Competitor scale-up spotted in Nutra US (internal brief)
brief-1.content: Internal note from your team: a competing agency appears to be scaling aggressively in the Nutra US vertical, based on creative volume spotted in ad libraries.
brief-1.recommendation: Review your own Nutra US creative refresh cadence — consider testing new angles sooner than planned.

brief-2.title: Chargeback pattern reported on a major crypto CPA network
brief-2.content: Several affiliates report a recent increase in chargebacks from one large crypto CPA network, with payouts being clawed back 2-3 weeks after initial approval.
brief-2.recommendation: Review recent payouts from this network for the affected offers; consider holding a portion of commission until the chargeback pattern is confirmed resolved.
